A Letter From The Heart
Dear Mummy 💌
There are no words grand enough to capture everything you are to us.

You are the one who held the family together through every season — through celebrations and quiet everyday moments — with the same warmth, the same patience, the same endless love.

You are the strength behind every smile in this family. Every good memory we carry has your love woven through it.

On this Mother's Day, we want you to know — you are the greatest blessing of our lives.

We love you more than words can ever say. Happy Mother's Day! 🌸
— With all our love, always 💛
